verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لِإِيلَـٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ

verses.english: For their taming (We cause) the caravans to set forth in winter and summer.
So let them worship the Lord of this House,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
verses.english: Who hath fed them against hunger and hath made them safe from fear.
